paragraphs.text: Coldraith (KOLD-rayth) was a wizard of Golthonor .

In the years 1280 and 1281 by the Reckoning of the Sages of Minorad , Coldraith diverted the flow of water of the Golthonor Torrent from the Great Salt Marshes of Western Golthonor to the Plains of Coloni , which would prevent an invasion by Ravidel through the waterways.

He had an army of brass men led by his spellsquire , and commanded a devouring deep . He remained safe inside his fortress, Coldraith's Keep , until Altair of Coloni and Caliphear the Nightmare led an army into the keep, where Coldraith was killed by Caliphear.
